notes.subject: teɣzi
notes.rationale: כבוד d-yessegzen 'taẓayt, tazwart'; teɣzi tettwafren axaṭer ulac awal n teqbaylit i yecuban, teɣzi n yiwen umkan d tin i d-ibanen.

notes.subject: כבודו
notes.rationale: Talɣa: 'teččur tmurt akk s teɣzi-nnes' (tiferkit-is tettwaḥrez ɣer teɣzi) neɣ 'taɣzi-is d tin i d-teččur tmurt' ( SUBJECT d a NAME-TIME). Talɣa tamenzut d tin i qqnen ɣer yiles n teɛbranit.

notes.subject: קדוש קדוש קדוש
notes.rationale: Allus krad n tikkal n 'iqedcen' — asemlal i d-ibanen deg teqbaylit, maca allus-agi d taẓuri n uḍris.

notes.subject: teččur tmurt akk
notes.rationale: Aḍris yeɛna tiɣzi s tmurt meṛṛa — tiɣzi n Yahwe tettwasen s usnubg-agi n tmurt.

translation: Yiwen yessawel ɣer wayeḍ, yenna: Iqedcen, iqedcen, iqedcen Yahwe Ṣebaot; teččur tmurt akk s teɣzi-nnes ⟨n⟩ yiqedcen-is.
